Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the location of the Scottish Parliament's modern equivalent. While it correctly identified the Parliament of Scotland as the body that approved the Directory, it stated the building is based at "The Mound (the General Assembly Hall)" in Edinburgh. This is factually incorrect. The General Assembly Hall is the meeting place of the Church of Scotland (the Presbyterian church), not the Scottish Parliament. The Scottish Parliament has been based at the **Scottish Parliament Building** (located on the Holyrood Park site) since 2004. The Planner failed to distinguish between the religious and political institutions, leading to the wrong final answer ("The Mound" vs "Scottish Parliament Building").
